card.title: Proxy pool
card.hint: Each account without its own proxy gets one proxy from the pool and keeps it. When a proxy fails three times in a row, its accounts move to a healthy one. Changes apply right away.
card.modeHint: Send accounts without their own proxy through the pool. An account's own proxy always comes first.
card.modeNeedsProxy: Add a proxy before you turn the pool on.
card.emptyOnWarning: The pool is on but has no proxies, so accounts use the global proxy or connect directly.
card.fallbackTitle: Fall back when no proxy is healthy
card.fallbackHint: Send requests through the global proxy, or directly if there is none. When off, requests fail until a pool proxy recovers.
card.intervalHint: How often to test each proxy by connecting to Kiro through it while the pool is on.
card.empty: No proxies yet. Add one to spread accounts over several outbound IP addresses.
card.removeBody: {name} leaves the pool. Its accounts move to the other proxies.
card.removeLastBody: {name} is the last proxy. Without it, accounts use the global proxy or connect directly.
failure.dns: Could not resolve the proxy host.
failure.auth: The proxy rejected the username or password.
failure.authRequired: The proxy asks for a username and password.
failure.tunnel: The proxy refused to connect to Kiro.
failure.unknown: The connection through the proxy failed.
editor.description: Accounts reach Kiro through this proxy. The password stays on the server and is never shown again.
editor.label: Label
editor.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
editor.added: The proxy was added and is being checked.
serverError.duplicate: This proxy is already in the pool.
serverError.notFound: This proxy is no longer in the pool.
serverError.empty: Add a proxy before you turn the pool on.
serverError.full: The pool is full. It can hold up to 100 proxies.
card.switchedOn: {name} is on and is being checked.
card.switchedOff: {name} is off. Its accounts moved to other proxies.
card.offNote: Switched off. It is not used or checked until you switch it on.
card.autoDisabledNote: Failed {max} times in a row, so it is out of rotation until a check passes.
card.strikesNote_one: Failed {count} time in a row. After {max}, its accounts move.
card.strikesNote_other: Failed {count} times in a row. After {max}, its accounts move.
counts.label: Proxies by state:
detected.title: Detected proxies
detected.hint: Proxies in use outside the pool: the global proxy and accounts' own. They are checked like pool proxies and never shared with other accounts.
detected.notShared: Has a sign-in, so it is never shared
detected.adoptTitle: Add this proxy to the pool?
detected.adoptBody: {name} joins the pool, and any account without its own proxy can then use it.
detected.adopted: {name} was added to the pool and is being checked.
serverError.detectedSignIn: A proxy with a sign-in stays with its owner and cannot join the pool.
